remarks: Discover this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in Brentwood, CA, located in the highly desirable Rose Garden neighborhood! Offering 2,372 square feet, this classic two-story home features one of Rose Garden's most popular floor plans. The upgraded kitchen boasts quartz countertops, freshly painted cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances, opening to a spacious family room. Perfect for entertaining, the home also features formal living and dining rooms plus a charming coffee bar. Recent upgrades include new laminate flooring downstairs, new bedroom carpeting, and fresh interior and exterior paint. all this and 18 Owned Solar Panels!
